subject: Post-demo: evaluation runbook, updated success metrics & suggested scope addition
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Langston <amy@cloudretail.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: evaluation runbook, updated success metrics & suggested scope addition

Hi Amy — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth as you decide on the trial: 

Quick recap
- Goal: validate Redwood for customer support + in-chat product recommendations at scale (primary 2 use cases).
- Immediate ask from you: confirm acceptance criteria and whether we should bring order-status extraction into the trial.

Proposed evaluation runbook (attached: eval_runbook_v2.xlsx) — summary highlights
- Success metrics (per-use-case):
  • Intent classification: macro F1 >= 0.88 on your representative dataset (sample payloads attached)
  • Entity extraction (product/order): extraction F1 >= 0.85 for product mentions; if we add order-status extraction, target F1 >= 0.90
  • Latency: p95 inference latency < 250ms for median request size (<= 512 tokens)
  • Reliability: 99.5% successful responses during a 72-hour soak test
  • Cost guardrail: target cost-per-1k-reqs < $8 (we will produce an estimate after we know traffic mix)

Suggested timeline
- Week 0 (this week): agree on final success metrics and sample payloads (owner: Amy + Monica)
- Week 1: data ingest + baseline run (owner: Monica + Redwood infra: Ben)
- Week 2: focused QA & alignment on failure cases (owners: Amy, Grace, Ben)
- Week 3: soak test + final acceptance review (owners: Amy, Grace)

Open items / asks for you
1) Confirm whether you want order-status extraction included in the trial (will add one evaluation track and extend timeline by ~1 week).
2) Share a small representative sample of chat transcripts and example order IDs (we included placeholder sample_payloads_order-status.jsonl attached).
3) Confirm target daily RPS (to size the soak test).

If you confirm the order-status use case, I propose we add a short alignment call tomorrow (30 minutes) to pin owners and adjust the runbook. Otherwise we proceed with the two original use cases.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Amy Langston <amy@cloudretail.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Riyaz Khan <riyaz@edgecommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: evaluation runbook, updated success metrics & suggested scope addition

Thanks Grace — very helpful summary. Two quick notes from our side: 

1) We do want order-status extraction in the trial. It’s a high-impact signal for routing and refunds. If we add that track, we need to raise the extraction acceptance to F1 >= 0.90 for order-status (we cannot accept many false positives on that field).

2) For sizing: our initial estimate is ~120 RPS peak for the chat endpoint and ~10k messages/day for the support channel. Monica will push a sanitized sample of transcripts and an export with order ID labels by EOD.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood will be able to surface per-token cost estimates for the trial (ballpark) so we can scope budget?

Happy to join a quick alignment tomorrow morning; Riyaz will be on the call to represent ops.

—Amy
Amy Langston
Head of ML Platforms, CloudRetail
amy@cloudretail.io | (212) 555-0123
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Langston <amy@cloudretail.io>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: evaluation runbook, updated success metrics & suggested scope addition

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 11:08 AM Amy Langston <amy@cloudretail.io> wrote:
> We do want order-status extraction in the trial...

Thanks — this is doable. A couple of operational details and a proposed small scope change: 

Operational notes
- Adding order-status extraction will add one evaluation track (entity extraction + canonicalization). We will validate both extraction quality and canonicalization (match to order IDs).
- Monica will own data ingestion and label mapping (as noted). Redwood infra will provide an initial cost projection after we receive the sample payload distribution.

Proposed scope amendment (to keep the trial timebox predictable)
- Add order-status extraction but keep soak test duration at 72 hours; instead of pushing other non-core intents beyond the trial, we’ll prioritize order-status + support routing + recommendations only.
- Move final acceptance review to Week 4 (one-week extension) — new finish = Week 4 end.

Owners & immediate next steps
- Data: Monica Patel (ingest, labels, sample payloads) — due Wed 2026-11-18 EOD
- Infra + cost estimate: Ben Carter (produce ballpark cost by Thu 2026-11-19)
- Evaluation runbook update: Grace (attach v2) — done (see attached)
- Ops alignment call: propose Wed 2026-11-18 09:30 PT (30m) — Grace to send calendar invite

Attachments included: eval_runbook_v2.xlsx, sample_payloads_order-status.jsonl.

I’ll start the cost calc once Monica drops the sample distribution.

Best,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Langston <amy@cloudretail.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Riyaz Khan <riyaz@edgecommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: evaluation runbook, updated success metrics & suggested scope addition

Perfect — thanks team. 

Confirmed: we will add the order-status extraction track and extend the trial finish by one week (final acceptance moved to end of Week 4). Calendar invite sent for Wed 2026-11-18 09:30 PT (ops alignment; 30m).

Immediate checklist (owners + deadlines):
- Monica: drop sanitized transcripts + labeled order-status export (sample_payloads_order-status.jsonl) — due 2026-11-18 EOD
- Ben: cost projection and expected p95 latency at target RPS — due 2026-11-19 EOD
- Grace: finalize eval_runbook_v2.xlsx and add a short section on canonicalization checks (attached) — done
- Amy / Riyaz: confirm soak window RPS threshold (they confirmed 120 RPS peak; please flag if that changes) — before 2026-11-18 call

We’ll treat canonicalization (order ID match rates) as a gating metric for the order-status track — target match >= 0.92. If canonicalization is below threshold at the end of the trial, we will recommend a short remediation sprint (1–2 weeks) rather than failing the entire POC.

If anything else to add, reply-all; otherwise I’ll move to lock the runbook and update the HubSpot deal (RDW-2031) with the amended timeline and owners.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
